settings.name: Notion Integration key

settings.tooltip: Notion integration secret stored in the OS keychain.

categories.name: Cards
categories.description: Card generation defaults and parser options.

settings.name: Default card type
settings.description: Default card type used for synced pages unless overridden per page.
settings.tooltip: Fallback card type for synced pages.

settings.name: Enable cloze parsing
settings.description: Convert marked top-level paragraphs and cloze toggles to numbered cloze cards.
settings.tooltip: Enable paragraph and toggle cloze card parsing.

settings.name: Convert gray toggles to cloze cards
settings.description: Treat top-level gray toggles as cloze cards when cloze parsing is enabled.
settings.tooltip: Turn gray top-level toggles into advanced cloze cards.

settings.name: Cloze marker colors
settings.description: Choose which Notion background colors create cloze deletions. Unselected colors remain visual formatting.
settings.tooltip: Select the background colors that should be converted into cloze deletions.

settings.name: Enable image occlusion parsing
settings.description: Enable image extraction for the Image Occlusion page.
settings.tooltip: Show image candidates for Image Occlusion workflows.

settings.name: Restore default card templates
settings.description: Overwrite Noteck card template HTML and styling with the bundled defaults.

categories.name: Sync
categories.description: Sync behavior between Notion and Anki.

settings.name: Run Notion sync when Anki syncs
settings.description: Start the Notion sync flow whenever the Anki Sync button is used.
settings.tooltip: Run Noteck sync before Anki sync.

settings.name: Notion → Anki auto-sync
settings.description: Automatically sync selected Notion pages when Anki starts.
settings.tooltip: Sync selected Notion pages when Anki starts.

settings.name: Pages tab selection behavior
settings.description: Choose how Pages tab checkboxes handle parent pages, existing child pages, and child pages discovered on later refreshes.
settings.tooltip: Choose how parent and child page checkboxes behave.

settings.name: Sync Notion now
settings.description: Run a manual Notion sync immediately.
